2026_01_ARI_LAC.headline: Los Angeles gets multiple Arizona pressure points across protection and the secondary
2026_01_ARI_LAC.paragraph1: The Cardinals ruled Isaiah Adams, Dadrion Taylor-Demerson and Garrett Williams out, with Jeremiyah Love questionable. The Chargers will be without Deane Leonard and list Tuli Tuipulotu as questionable. Arizona’s absences reach the offensive line and defensive backfield at the same time, giving Los Angeles two different ways to press the game. The Chargers can test protection with movement up front and then force a shortened Cardinals secondary to cover layered concepts; Arizona needs tempo and ball control to reduce those exposures.
2026_01_ARI_LAC.model_rationale: Los Angeles can pressure two weakened areas of Arizona’s roster at once, creating complementary advantages in pass protection stress and downfield coverage spacing.
